verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion is a fair privacy question for a domain registrar that holds registrant data. The evidence only documents WHOIS redaction and the ability to edit contact data, and it states that Cloudflare stores the authentic WHOIS record. None of this lets users set retention periods or delete their data, so it counts as adjacent privacy controls rather than this capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
